title: Marker token prefix changes from @forger: to @kaava:
context: Legacy Forger code uses `@forger:` prefix. HELVE rebranding requires updating the marker token.
decision: Replace all `@forger:` marker tokens with `@kaava:` to align with the HELVE rebranding. Existing `@forger:` tokens will not be recognized by the reconciler.
consequences: All marker tokens in existing projects must be updated (manual or automated); reconciliation against old code bases will report `present_unknown` for `@forger:` tokens; backward compatibility is not maintained; migration path needed for teams with existing markers.
